objective: Read only evidence-backed downstream affiliate metrics from the existing GetGenie affiliate area and reconcile them into revenue truth without changing the verified tracking URL.
unknown_policy: Any field not explicitly shown remains unknown; never convert blank or missing values to zero.
do_not: Do not create another GetGenie account or affiliate application.
Do not replace the verified customer-facing URL with a dashboard, login, onboarding, or generic homepage URL.
Do not self-refer, purchase, start a paid plan, or change payout details.
Do not expose credentials or account-security information in GitHub, files, or chat.
Do not infer signup, paid customer, commission, payout, or revenue from link issuance or HTTP success alone.
done_when: Exact current downstream totals are recorded in projects/GlobalSaaSHub/data/revenue-truth-2026-09-11.json with source and timestamp, or every unavailable field is explicitly unknown.
